hebrewText: וְ/הָי֤וּ כְ/גִבּוֹר֙ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְ/שָׂמַ֥ח לִבָּ֖/ם כְּמוֹ יָ֑יִן וּ/בְנֵי/הֶם֙ יִרְא֣וּ וְ/שָׂמֵ֔חוּ יָגֵ֥ל לִבָּ֖/ם בַּ/יהוָֽה

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.
champion, chief, [idiom] excel, giant, man, mighty (man, one), strong (man), valiant man.

tokens.bdb: Ephrajim, a son of Joseph; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
tokens.kjv: cheer up, be (make) glad, (have, make) joy(-ful), be (make) merry, (cause to, make to) rejoice, [idiom] very.

tokens.bdb: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
